styleSelection.reason: The reference is carried by warm masonry value planes, crisp Gothic openings and a small amount of fine structural ink; detailed architecture at native 1200 px.

Y1.sky.reason: Pale blue sky and soft cloud whites; broad connected watery wash, kept outside the sharply cut roofs. Sky is a wash question, no outlining or texture marks.

Y1.main-gable.reason: Sunlit golden gable, pale quoins and paired pointed arches are the focal architecture. Broad light wash then dry shaped mid planes and one connected shadow glaze; thin mullions belong to drawing.

Y1.left-wing.reason: Cooler ochre side wall and rectangular windows; coherent shaded wall planes, dry crisp window recesses, restrained warm stone tooth only after the foundation.

Y1.left-chimney.reason: Tall cropped chimney with projecting cap and vertical flues; warm light right edge against cool side, drawing carries the narrow flue divisions.

Y1.right-wing.reason: Right chimney and receding wing with slate roof and stacked windows; slightly quieter values and less drawing than the central gable.

Y1.foreground-tree.reason: Yellow-green foreground canopy beside the doorway; connected irregular foliage wash, dry connected shadow groups and a few crisp tapered branch accents; no equal leaf disks.

Y1.street.reason: Small people, pavement, banners and traffic signal anchor the base. Broad neutral base; dry dark accents, no invented faces or lettering.
